title: Peitho API request envelope

request_id.description: Correlation identifier generated by the client; the server validates its format and returns the accepted request ID.

data.description: Operation-specific request body. Validate it against the endpoint's dedicated schema.

description: Generic envelope only; endpoint-specific schemas define data fields. Tenant and authorization context must be resolved from authenticated identity/scopes, not trusted from a client-supplied tenant_id.
